answer: Score each pair of identities on how alike their answer style, request timing and wallet funding are. Pairs above a threshold are merged into one grove that shares a single payout, so a garden of 100 clones earns what one agent earns. The kernel of the defence is a bounty: any grader who proves two accounts belong to the same hidden grove takes part of their stake, which makes hiding a farm costlier than running one honest agent.
